description: The pie chart represents the distribution of data sources in the combined training set for a study on automatic evaluation of attribution by large language models. There are a total of 12 slices, each corresponding to a different data source. The largest slice, representing 31.3%, is labeled "NQ," followed by "SNLI" at 15.4%, and "Fever" at 16.1%. "VITAMINC" accounts for 13.0% of the data source distribution. The remaining slices are significantly smaller, with "XSUMHUL" at 1.6%, "SCITAIL" at 1.2%, "PUBHEALTH" at 0.5%, "MULTINLI" at 11.3%, "MULTIFC" at 0.5%, "SCIFACT" at 0.1%, "ENTFA" at 1.8%, "FACTCC" at 2.6%, and "ANLI" at 4.6%. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are labeled inside the corresponding slices. No slices are visually emphasized in any particular way.
